MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing fits the wiring work suggested by my battery holder, relay, and circuit boards; it would help me insulate connections as I assemble projects.",
    "The digital caliper would help me check small component dimensions and fit, making it useful across my electronics and fabrication projects."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The epoxies, glue, and cleaner could be useful someday, but I have no current bonding, repair, or cleaning task that makes them worth choosing now.",
    "The cutting wheels assume I need to cut metal and have a compatible tool, while the nut assortment assumes sizes I have not shown a need for.",
    "Eighteen rolls of duct tape and twelve tubes of glue feel excessive for my occasional project work.",
    "Another infrared thermometer repeats a tool I already purchased without giving me a clear reason to replace it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in building small electronic projects seems to have been stretched into a general need for workshop supplies.",
    "Having bought a particular tool seems to be treated as a reason to buy another similar one, even when the first may still meet my needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Supplies that complete a practical step in my circuit projects, such as insulating wires, matter more to me than a broad connection to DIY work.",
    "I choose moderately and need a concrete use; a potentially handy product or a large quantity is not enough on its own.",
    "My purchases span years, so an older purchase does not necessarily mean I am still doing that task or need more of the same item."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical project interests but often confused useful additions for small electronics work with general workshop supplies or tools I already own."
}
